USER: Hi, I just moved to a new house and need to set up internet and cable service.
ASSISTANT: Welcome to Velocity Communications! I'm Derek, and I'll be happy to help you set up your services today. First, let me get your service address.
USER: It's 7622 Willow Creek Drive, Austin, Texas, 78759.
ASSISTANT: Great location! Let me check what services are available there... Excellent news! You qualify for our fiber optic services with speeds up to 2 gigabits. May I have your name?
USER: I'm Kevin Zhang.
ASSISTANT: Thank you, Mr. Zhang. Are you looking for internet only, or would you like to bundle with cable TV and phone?
USER: I definitely need internet. Tell me about the cable packages too.
ASSISTANT: Sure! For internet, we have three tiers: Essential at 300 Mbps for $49.99, Performance at 1 Gig for $79.99, and Ultimate at 2 Gigs for $119.99 per month.
USER: I work from home and do a lot of video calls. What would you recommend?
ASSISTANT: For working from home with video calls, I'd recommend at least the Performance 1 Gig plan. It provides excellent upload and download speeds for smooth video conferencing.
USER: What about the cable packages?
ASSISTANT: We have Select with 125+ channels for $64.99, Preferred with 200+ channels plus HBO and Showtime for $94.99, and Premier with 300+ channels plus all premium channels for $134.99.
USER: Do you have sports channels in the Select package?
ASSISTANT: Select includes ESPN, ESPN2, and Fox Sports regional networks. For NFL Network, NBA TV, and NFL RedZone, you'd need Preferred or higher.
USER: I'm a big basketball fan, so I'd need NBA TV. What's the total for Performance internet and Preferred cable?
ASSISTANT: Performance internet at $79.99 plus Preferred cable at $94.99 would be $174.98, but I can offer you a bundle discount of $25 per month, bringing it to $149.98.
USER: That's not bad. What about equipment fees?
ASSISTANT: The fiber modem/router combo is $12 per month. Each cable box is $7.99 for standard or $12.99 for DVR-enabled boxes. How many TVs do you have?
USER: I have three TVs - living room, master bedroom, and my home office.
ASSISTANT: I'd recommend a DVR box for your living room so you can record games and shows, and standard boxes for the other two. That would be $12.99 plus two at $7.99 each.
USER: So that's about $29 in equipment fees?
ASSISTANT: Actually, $28.97 for the cable boxes plus $12 for the modem/router, so $40.97 total in equipment fees.
USER: What would my total monthly bill be then?
ASSISTANT: Your services at $149.98 plus equipment at $40.97 equals $190.95 per month, plus taxes and fees which are typically around $12-15 in your area.
USER: Are there any promotions for new customers?
ASSISTANT: Yes! New customers get the first three months at 50% off the service charges, and we waive the installation fee which is normally $99.99.
USER: So I'd pay about $95 for the first three months?
ASSISTANT: For the services portion, yes - $74.99 for the first three months, plus the $40.97 equipment fees, so roughly $116 before taxes.
USER: Okay, let's do it. When can you install?
ASSISTANT: Let me check our installation calendar... I have openings this Saturday November 11th in the afternoon, or next Tuesday November 14th in the morning.
USER: What time on Tuesday?
ASSISTANT: We have an 8 AM to 12 PM window or a 10 AM to 2 PM window available.
USER: I'll take the 10 AM to 2 PM on Tuesday the 14th.
ASSISTANT: Perfect! I've scheduled your installation for Tuesday, November 14th between 10 AM and 2 PM. Our technician will call 30 minutes before arrival.
USER: Do I need to be home?
ASSISTANT: Yes, someone 18 or older needs to be present as the technician will need access inside to set up your equipment and activate services.
USER: That's fine. Now what information do you need from me?
ASSISTANT: I'll need your date of birth for the account setup.
USER: April 3rd, 1987.
ASSISTANT: And your Social Security number for the credit check?
USER: It's 455-78-9234.
ASSISTANT: Thank you. Running that now... You're approved with no deposit required! What's the best phone number to reach you?
USER: My cell is 512-555-8823.
ASSISTANT: Email address for your account and bills?
USER: kzhang87@email.com
ASSISTANT: Perfect. Would you like paperless billing?
USER: Yes, definitely paperless.
ASSISTANT: Great choice! You'll get a $5 monthly discount for paperless billing with autopay. Would you like to set up autopay?
USER: What are the autopay options?
ASSISTANT: You can use a checking account, savings account, or credit/debit card. The payment processes on your due date each month.
USER: I'll use my checking account. It's with Chase Bank.
ASSISTANT: I'll need your routing number and account number.
USER: Routing is 111000614 and account is 8829447651.
ASSISTANT: Thank you. Your autopay is set up and your adjusted monthly rate with the paperless discount is $185.95 plus taxes and fees.
USER: When will my first bill be?
ASSISTANT: Your first bill will generate about 10 days after installation, so around November 24th, due 20 days later on December 14th.
USER: And that will be at the promotional rate?
ASSISTANT: Yes, your first three bills will show the 50% discount on services. After that, it goes to regular pricing.
USER: What channels are included in HBO?
ASSISTANT: You get HBO, HBO2, HBO Family, HBO Latino, HBO Signature, HBO Comedy, HBO Zone, plus HBO Max streaming access.
USER: Oh, streaming is included?
ASSISTANT: Yes! With Preferred package, you get HBO Max and Showtime streaming apps included at no extra charge. You can use them on any device.
USER: That's great. What about a streaming device for my TVs?
ASSISTANT: Our cable boxes have built-in streaming apps, or you can use your own devices like Roku or Apple TV with your login credentials.
USER: Do the cable boxes need to be connected to the internet?
ASSISTANT: They work best when connected to your home network for on-demand content and streaming apps. The technician will connect them during installation.
USER: How many devices can use the internet simultaneously?
ASSISTANT: With the 1 Gig plan, you can easily support 25+ devices simultaneously. Our router supports up to 150 connected devices.
USER: Is the WiFi dual-band?
ASSISTANT: Yes, it's WiFi 6 with both 2.4GHz and 5GHz bands, plus it automatically optimizes which band each device uses.
USER: Can I use my own router?
ASSISTANT: You can, but you'd still need our modem for the fiber connection. If you use your own router, we can reduce the equipment fee to $7 for just the modem.
USER: I'll stick with yours for now. Is there a contract?
ASSISTANT: No long-term contract required! It's month-to-month service. You can cancel anytime with 30 days notice.
USER: What if I want to upgrade or downgrade services?
ASSISTANT: You can change your package anytime. Upgrades take effect immediately, downgrades at the start of your next billing cycle.
USER: Good to know. What's my account number going to be?
ASSISTANT: Your new account number is VEL-89923476. You'll use this for all service requests.
USER: VEL-89923476, got it. Do you have a mobile app?
ASSISTANT: Yes! The Velocity app lets you manage your account, pay bills, troubleshoot issues, and even watch live TV on your mobile devices.
USER: Can I set up parental controls?
ASSISTANT: Absolutely. Both the internet router and cable boxes have comprehensive parental controls you can manage through the app or web portal.
USER: Perfect. What if I have technical issues?
ASSISTANT: We have 24/7 technical support at 1-800-VELOCITY. Most issues can be resolved remotely, but we offer free service calls if needed.
USER: Is there anything I need to do before the installation?
ASSISTANT: Just ensure clear access to where you want the equipment installed and have your TVs ready. The technician will handle all the wiring and setup.
USER: How long does installation usually take?
ASSISTANT: For three TVs and internet, typically 2-3 hours depending on your home's wiring situation.
USER: Sounds good. I think I'm all set.
ASSISTANT: Perfect! Let me confirm everything: Kevin Zhang at 7622 Willow Creek Drive, Austin. Installation on Tuesday, November 14th, 10 AM-2 PM. Performance 1 Gig internet and Preferred cable package with one DVR and two standard boxes. Account number VEL-89923476. Monthly rate $185.95 after discounts, with first three months at 50% off services. Is everything correct?
USER: Yes, that's all correct. Thank you!
ASSISTANT: You're welcome, Mr. Zhang! You'll receive a confirmation email at kzhang87@email.com shortly. Our technician will see you on Tuesday. Thank you for choosing Velocity Communications!
